Results.ReviewText: We assembled the E-210 Spirit II Grill ourselves.  Easy, and a very sturdy grill.  Then had to try it out with a barbecued steak.  (1) The propane tank is easy to install and remove...and I like the spring gauge that tells how full the tank is.  Compared it to a pressure gauge and it was spot on!, (2) I like the piezo spark button.  Easier than on our old grill.  (3) The steak came out perfect, but I expected that.  We have a small Weber at home purchased 10 years ago that still cooks up a great barbecue. (4) The drip pan works far better than any other brand of grill.  In the past I had to fabricate drip pans for other grills...those never quite worked right.  Weber knows how to do it. (5) And best of all, the grill top itself cleans up easily.  After it cools, we take it to the kitchen sink, use a rough scrubbing sponge and soap, and in a minute have a clean grill top for the next barbecue. (6) Haven't really had a chance to use the thermometer except to know when the grill is ready.  But a nice touch...especially if a rotisserie is added.
Results.Title: Love the Spirit II Grill

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
